scope: Full Windows/Ubuntu core, actual VS Code development/production installation and packaged-tool verification. HTTP model responses are controlled fixtures; private native-return comparisons and actual model semantic review are separate.

checks: Preview values: actual worker/controller and two-way VS Code webview JSON transport preserve NaN, infinities, negative-zero inputs/results and present undefined properties; ordinary strings stay distinct in trace, comparison and Markdown without source edits
Trace source handles: unknown handles, stale contexts, superseded results and invalid indexes are rejected; clients cannot supply a navigation path
Trace source freshness: an unopened imported file changed on disk is rejected before showing a stale line, even without an editor change notification

Trace source navigation: actual worker/controller opens exact imported condition, loop, callback and return lines across files with duplicate basenames; returned-data mutation cannot redirect selection; source text stays unchanged

Explanation arithmetic: actual worker records original expressions and evaluated operand/result values for zero division and signed infinity, separately from the returned object, with no model inference

Explanation execution records: actual worker records a source-linked return; nested client mutation cannot change host evidence or navigation, and invalid record indexes are rejected without model inference
Explanation observations: actual worker calculates selected JS/TS examples and preserves special values without contacting any model; invalid argument lists are rejected

localArtifactMatch.scope: Local worker used for unchanged private examples and built UI used for public browser checks match these installed artifacts on both operating systems.

firstFailedRun.cause: An existing test assumed the returned object was the first trace entry. Arithmetic now precedes it.
firstFailedRun.correction: The test-only follow-up selects explicit return records and retains special-value assertions, also removing the equivalent native-test assumption. Runtime files are unchanged.

limitations: Same tests across OS/install modes are not independent feature counts.
No new model inference for arithmetic records; previous actual-model semantic failure remains.
Bounded JS/TS arithmetic observations do not establish whole-app behavior, all-language support, scientific validity or performance gains.
Not merged, deployed or a stable release.
